reference: Exact binary-fraction CMYK endpoint/midpoint values across a discontinuous two-interval function; domain clamping and right-interval selection at Bounds=0.5, using real domain endpoints instead of compatibility epsilon sentinels.
failure: Malformed output widths, out-of-domain bounds and reversed parent output range are refused. Public output stays unchanged on every tested refusal/cancellation.
limitations: Native AI shading event capture/replay is not yet connected to this function API; AI remains unqualified.
Multi-output sampled/calculator functions remain unsupported; scalar fallback retains previously bounded evaluator.
Retained function metadata parsing/allocation is separate from bounded evaluation scratch.
Original components retain existing f32 function precision, not exact original PDF decimal precision.
No Poppler image match, physical Metal/HDR or general format qualification claimed.
